sources.title: Google Scholar
sources.snippet: Google Scholar provides a simple way to broadly search for scholarly literature. Search across a wide variety of disciplines and sources: articles, theses, books, abstracts and court opinions.

sources.title: Multitask Vision Transformer Predicts Molecular and Prognostic Features ...
sources.snippet: Researchers developed an AI-based Vision Transformer model to analyze routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained whole-slide images and then simultaneously predict cancer subtype, TP53 mutation status, and survival outcomes across 32 solid tumors. Study findings were published in The American Journal of Pathology.

sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
sources.snippet: Multi puts 300+ models from every major lab to work across four workflows, so you deploy the best AI for each task instead of forcing one to do it all. Using the right model for the right project is the advantage most people leave on the table.
